name: Particle effects
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Particle effects made easy*! Make your own fire, smoke, wind, sparkle and other effects!

*as long as you know math.

Valid operators are +, -, *, ** (power), / and % (remainder).
Valid functions are ln, sin, cos, tan, sqrt, abs, round, var, min and max. min and max are the only functions which accept multiple arguments separated by comma. var returns the value of the game variable of given id. If the argument provided is not an integer, it is rounded.
Valid values are t, r, r2 and sq. t is the time (in seconds) since that particle was spawned. r and r2 are random values between 0 and 1 for that particle assigned at spawn. sq is the square size.

Tip: try this graphing calculator to help visualize formulas: https://www.desmos.com/calculator

commands.name: Start particle effect
commands.description: Start a particle effect centered at a specified map object

defaultParameters.name: object
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object to anchor the effect to (the emitter). -1 is self, 0 is hero

defaultParameters.name: rate
defaultParameters.description: Rate (particles per second) at which new particles are spawned

defaultParameters.name: lifespan
defaultParameters.description: Time (in seconds) at which the particles are despawned

defaultParameters.name: position
defaultParameters.description: Math formula for the particle position on all 3 axes. t is the time, r and r2 are random numbers between 0 and 1, and sq is the square size.

defaultParameters.name: rotation
defaultParameters.description: Rotation, in degrees. t is the time, r and r2 are random numbers between 0 and 1

defaultParameters.name: size
defaultParameters.description: Math formula for the size of the particle. t is the time, r is a random number between 0 and 1

defaultParameters.name: opacity
defaultParameters.description: Math formula for the particle's opacity. t is the time, r is a random number between 0 and 1

defaultParameters.name: texture
defaultParameters.description: Texture of the particle (stored at this plugin folder, inside "textures" subfolder)

defaultParameters.name: additiveBlending
defaultParameters.description: Turn OFF to make the particle texture opaque

commands.name: End particle effect
commands.description: Terminate particle effect at a given object

defaultParameters.name: object
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object where the particle effect is running

defaultParameters.name: smooth
defaultParameters.description: Set to OFF to terminate instantly
